thread:
elaine_marketing: Hey team — quick sync. We need a tight one-pager (PDF + HTML) for enterprise buyers that covers security, SLA tiers, and deploy modes. Goal: field-ready by next Tue. link: https://go/docs/enterprise-onepager-draft :eyes:

josh_product: +1. Should call out Hosted / Dedicated / Private clearly and include a short decision flow for common buyer profiles.

maria_sales: Can we add an inbound-routing note? sales ops needs a routing trigger (usage threshold + gov/reg flag) so leads get funneled to AE team.

tim_engineering: For SLAs, propose we show latency SLOs for p50/p95 on typical gen workloads and a committed uptime % for Dedicated. Example numbers we can use in draft: `p50: 60–120ms (small models), p95: 300–600ms; Dedicated SLA: 99.9% availability`

harper_design: I can do the layout. Can we standardize iconography for each deploy mode and add a tiny benchmark sparkline? Also need final logo lockups (dark/light).

elaine_marketing: Good — keep wording concise. Prioritize 2 use cases: regulated fintech (VPC + KMS + audit logs) and a high-traffic consumer app (Dedicated throughput/cost controls).

josh_product: For benchmark narrative, suggest a 2‑line callout: "Real app: 10k QPS burst, 1k sustained users — lowest per-token cost with batching + prefix caching vs self-hosting". We can link to a longer benchmark blog.

maria_sales: On routing: trigger when monthly usage > $5k OR security flag `requires-vpc` true. Send to AE queue `enterprise-inbound` and CC solutions_eng.

sam_ops: FYI — for Private we should note on-prem packaging window (4–6 weeks) and required IP allowlist steps.

harper_design: To confirm file outputs: 1-page PDF (A4), slide deck 1–2 slides, web snippet (300–500 words). I'll mock by EOD Thu.

elaine_marketing: Timeline: draft by Thu EOD, internal review Fri, field review Mon, final Tue morning. Assigning owners: Elaine = PM, Harper = design, Josh = product copy, Maria = routing + field notes, Tim = infra/metrics, Sam = ops compliance checklist.

josh_product: I'll drop copy edits in the doc tonight: https://go/docs/enterprise-onepager-draft (commenting enabled).

maria_sales: I'll add the routing rules and AE handoff template.

tim_engineering: I'll upload a small table of p50/p95 numbers and test config snippet. Example config to include in appendix:
```yaml
batching: auto
kv_cache: enabled
quantization_profile: int8
```

elainE_marketing: (typo) — meant to say thanks! :sweat_smile:

elaine_marketing: Quick decision point: do we include pricing ranges on the one-pager or keep "contact sales"? Thoughts.

josh_product: Keep ranges high-level (e.g., "starts at $X/mo for hosted; committed pricing for Dedicated"). Avoid exact numbers.

maria_sales: Agree — include CTA button that opens a pre-filled routing form so AEs get context.

sam_ops: One more ops note: include KMS integrations list (AWS KMS, GCP KMS, Azure Key Vault) and mention SOC2 / ISO27001 in the footer.

elaine_marketing: Perfect. I'll consolidate action items and set up a quick 15-min review Friday 10am. If anyone can't make it, add comments in the doc. :thumbsup:

harper_design: On it. Will post mock links in thread when ready.

josh_product: Thanks — will add benchmark callouts and webinar tie-in bullet (30-min webinar + demo) so field has assets.

maria_sales: Will prep AE briefing and inbound form.

tim_engineering: Sending numbers now, expect a short spreadsheet.

elaine_marketing: Great — closing loop. Friday review = cadence.
